verdict.rationale: Canny's in-product Autopilot automatically extracts feature requests from call transcripts, support, sales and review sources. That amounts to automated suggestions of untracked feedback, though the evidence never explicitly calls it AI. The insight-style analysis (top themes, ARR impact across ideas, roadmap queries) is delivered through external LLMs such as ChatGPT, Claude or Cursor via the MCP server, not inside Canny itself. Missing for 10: documented in-product AI-generated insights or summaries (themes, trends, prioritization suggestions), an explicit description of Autopilot as AI, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
